text_blocks.snippet: Gitanjali was written by the Bengali poet Rabindranath Tagore.

list.snippet: Original Publication: Published in Bengali in 1910.
English Translation: Translated by Tagore as Gitanjali: Song Offerings in 1912.
Nobel Prize: Won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913, making Tagore the first non-European to receive the honor.
